name: Landhaus Bergfried
beschreibung: Landhaus Bergfried enjoys a peaceful and sunny hillside location in the scenic village of Thiersee in the Kufstein district. Surrounded by vibrant alpine meadows and fragrant pine forests, guest rooms and holiday apartments boast private balconies framing spectacular views of the Kaisergebirge and surrounding Tyrolean peaks. In summer, scenic hiking and mountain biking trails depart right from the doorstep, with Lake Thiersee offering refreshing swims nearby. Winter visitors appreciate peaceful winter walks, cross-country ski tracks, and friendly local family ski slopes.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming alpine country house on a sunny hillside in Thiersee overlooking the Kaisergebirge.
